kjv: they go down quick into the pit
mine: they go down alive into Sheol
note: chayyim she'olah: "quick" (alive) is archaic. she'ol is the realm of the dead, not a literal pit. Same in v. 33.

kjv: these men have provoked the LORD
note: ni'atsu means "spurned, treated with contempt". "Provoked" misses the sense.
